description: This file contains predicate-related functions for building, parsing, and converting predicates used in a query or filtering system. It includes functions for creating predicates from arguments, JSON, and DSL strings, as well as internal helpers for predicate validation and conversion.

methods.name: predicateFromArguments
methods.description: Creates a predicate based on provided keypath, operator, and value, handling different predicate types.

methods.name: compoundPredicateFromArguments
methods.description: Constructs a compound predicate from an operator and an array of predicate JSON forms.

methods.name: notPredicateFromArguments
methods.description: Creates a NotPredicate from a JSON predicate form.

methods.name: includesPredicateFromArguments
methods.description: Creates an IncludesPredicate with a keypath and a JSON predicate.

methods.name: predicateFromJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON predicate form into a PredicateInterface object.

methods.name: predicateFromDSLString
methods.description: Parses a DSL string into a predicate object.
